name: Sweet Dew Needles (Cam Lộ Châm)
lore: Nine silver-and-boxwood needles in a roll of green silk. Mai Lễ Tuyền's master Liêm Cam Lộ made them; Mai has used them on fever towns, drunken elders and once, in 950, on a woman giving birth at dawn on the shore of Triêu Hà Hồ (A261).
build_use: The head's healing weapon: needle arts that mend instead of wound.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Seal of the Hundred Jars (Bách Úng Ấn)
lore: The cellar seal pressed into the clay of every jar the school sends to the Pivot's table since 1140 (A263). Nhạc Thuần Nhưỡng had it cut from Ngọa Ngưu Sơn stone when the first order came, and he has pressed it into rather more than a hundred jars a year.
build_use: The wine-master's piece: heavier Water stacks and a drunken foe.

name: Robe of the Red Dawn (Triêu Hà Bào)
lore: A white healer's robe with one red cloud embroidered at the hem, sewn after the dawn of 950 on the shore of Triêu Hà Hồ, when she delivered the girl who became the palace's head (A261).
build_use: Keeps her side standing longest: healing and regeneration.

name: Cup of the Sweet Spring (Cam Tuyền Hồ)
lore: A white gourd filled at the spring itself, never at the cellars. She does not let the wine-master fill it.
build_use: The tide that fills her before it breaks: linh lực and Water buff stacks.
